key_phrases: firming up our wafer pricing to a reasonable level
capacity shortage will continue throughout this year and may be extended into 2022
analysis.reasoning: The company is exhibiting extremely high confidence in its long-term growth, evidenced by the massive $100 billion CapEx commitment over three years. While short-term gross margins are under pressure due to node complexity and utilization levels, management is signaling strong pricing power through 'firming up' prices. Demand for advanced nodes (5nm/3nm) is described as structurally increasing, and despite geopolitical risks and supply chain disruptions, the company maintains a very low level of evasiveness in Q&A, directly addressing competition (Intel) and expansion plans (Arizona).
